prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1165; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision involving a vehicle insured under your policy. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already made contact with our client, please let us know immediately.

We request that you provide the full liability and bodily injury policy limits applicable to the insured driver and vehicle, along with a certified copy of the declarations page. Please also confirm whether any other coverage, such as umbrella or excess coverage, may apply.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data, dashcam or telematics records, claim notes, recorded statements, adjuster reports, and any repair or total-loss estimates. Please ensure that no vehicle involved is repaired, salvaged, or disposed of without prior written notice to this office.

Kindly acknowledge receipt of this letter within fourteen days.
